business_summary: Care Twentyone Corporation operates as a comprehensive welfare company in Japan. The company offers home care, paid nursing home, dementia group home, in-home care support, small-scale multi-functional home care, day service, and welfare equipment rental/home renovation services. It also provides support services for people with disabilities; and childcare, home nursing care, home nursing care, medical support, acupuncture and massage, human resource placement and dispatch, lifestyle support, dinning, real estate, and Type A and Type B continuous employment support, as well as employment services for people with disabilities. In addition, the company operates nursing qualification training schools. Care Twentyone Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Care Twentyone Corporation은 일본에서 종합 복지 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 홈케어, 유료요양원, 치매그룹홈, 재택간호지원, 소규모 다기능 홈케어, 데이서비스, 복지기기 대여/주택개량 서비스 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 장애인을 위한 지원 서비스도 제공합니다. 보육, 가정간호, 가정간호, 의료지원, 침술 및 안마, 인력배치 및 파견, 생활지원, 외식, 부동산, A·B형 계속취업지원, 장애인 취업서비스 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 당사는 간호자격훈련학교를 운영하고 있습니다. Care Twentyone Corporation은 1993년에 설립되었으며 일본 오사카에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
